SS-IL-WEAVING.Purpose: Post-compilation IL transformation stage: redirect annotated auto-properties onto implementations generated by the source-generator pipeline.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Fody ModuleWeaver over compiled FlexVerse-referencing assemblies using Mono.Cecil.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Source-level code production — owned by SS-SOURCE-GENERATORS.

Principles.PRIN-001: The weaver is a pure rewriter: it changes redirection, never semantics.

Requirements.REQ-001: A missing generated counterpart for an annotated property fails the build with an explicit weaver error.
